nativeContract.dto: camelCase exact fields: state=complete|partial|interrupted; reasons=deduplicated fixed enum array; excludedUnits:[video,audio] u64; excludedBytes:[video,audio] u64. No arbitrary messages/paths/URLs/clock guesses. At most100000 excluded units per track and128GiB combined excluded bytes, checked sums. nativeContract.projection: Use PublicationSourceFacts only. Sum each track's disjoint leading/trailing excluded units/bytes plus its uncommitted bytes once; never double-count reason flags. Native validation rejects impossible overflow/bounds. AAC packets trimmed strictly outside the selected video interval and complete AAC units excluded solely as outside_selected_video remain observable counts but do not themselves imply lost video or a partial recording.
nativeContract.precedence: Interrupted if source state is Interrupted, seal missing, or cause is Interrupted/Cancelled/Limit. Preserve all observed fixed reasons, including partial flags. Otherwise Partial for any incomplete append, torn journal, uncommitted bytes, partial-tail/incomplete-structure, excluded video units/bytes or coverage loss. Complete only for proven explicit Stopped with none of those conditions. FormatBoundary is conservatively Partial+format_boundary in this first batch until root explicitly approves a normal-continuation interpretation; it is not silently Complete. selected=true alone is not failure and selected-complete may be Complete.
